description.en: Application ID. You can create and view this ID in the console. Only one ID is supported.

title.en: Query the status of the recording feature

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

The QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second per user. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business. Call this operation only as needed.
